response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_average, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_average) AS amount_average, AVG(balance_average) AS balance_average FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_average) AS mean_amount_average FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.amount_average, r.balance_average, r.amount_average / o.mean_amount_average AS amount_average_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_amount_average IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount_average <> 0
